_help: One vehicle TYPE. The game's own list lives in content/vehicles.json next to the game (seeded from the built-in UK fleet, see vehicles/uk-fleet.json here for the full current catalogue). Keys starting with _ are notes.
_key: referenced by call files (units block), seed stations and saves. Never rename once used.
label: Rescue Pump
_defaultName: the callsign a new vehicle of this type starts with (real UK radio shorthand: IRV, ARV, RRV, ALP ...).
_crew: MissionChief UK crew range; standardCrew is how many named personnel the vehicle is seeded with (personnel.ts).
_costGbp: real purchase price in pounds, new and fitted out (used by the purchase flow later).
_training: training catalogue keys every crew member must hold, see vehicles/training.json.
ukNote: Which UK services actually run this vehicle.
_deskOnly: true for units only a desk tasks (hems, npas, ccp_car): the player never suggests or dispatches them.
